tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0019 1. Lemma 1.12\group model-geometries

If $\Isom (\M ^n,g)$ acts transitively on $\M ^n$, then all isotropy groups $I_x(\M ^n,g)$ are isomorphic.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0019 \sketch Given any $x,y \in \M ^n$, choose an isometry $\gamma $ with $\gamma (x)=y$. Conjugation by $\gamma $ defines an isomorphism from $I_x(\M ^n,g)$ to $I_y(\M ^n,g)$, with inverse given by conjugation by $\gamma ^{-1}$.

□
